responsibility: This file implements the generic RTL analysis framework that discovers doloop-style loops and hands them to target-specific hardware loop optimizers late in the backend. It identifies loops by tracking loop_end patterns and iteration registers, computes loop membership, nesting, incoming edges, register and control-flow properties, optionally reorders blocks to satisfy hardware-loop layout constraints, and then calls target hooks to either optimize valid loops or split/fail bad ones. It is the reusable target-facing infrastructure behind late hardware loop formation from existing doloop constructs.
same_name_distinction: Contains the backend analysis and transformation driver for hardware doloops: loop discovery, CFG/register-property scanning, optional block reordering, and depth-first invocation of target hooks. The header defines the hwloop_info representation and hook interface used by that engine.
